text:
Great Smokey bbq spot.
Certainly not an obvious place as it's one off the Blvd. ... hence the name I assume.
jerk chicken was very tasty.
Stop by it's a chill spot with good food

after ordering a bit more red sauce in a tiny sauce dish because the first one was too small, I was charged $2.00 extra.  This was uncalled for and nickel and diming the customer.  I will not be returning.  Hope they enjoy my $2.00.  Food was OK.  Anti Pasto salad was more like a salad from a Jewish Deli.

My husband and I found this restaurant on Uber Eats and I'm so glad we did. Everything we ordered was delicious and tasty. The food tastes very authentic. The pitas are so delicious I recommend the Chicken Shawarma and Gyro Plate
What a find! Helpful staff, creative and yummy selections. Wish we had one closer to home. Really hit the spot.

I was really in the mood to eat a grouper ruben and chill outside with a beer today. That didn't happen here. The service made it impossible to chill. It seemed hard to get table service and when someone did notice us she seemed annoyed. I thought about getting up and leaving but was afraid to cancel my order because the waitress was so rude. So instead I got a grouper ruben, but on a hamburger bun because they were out of rye bread AND out of French fires. Our waitress also had very little knowledge of any drinks (craft beer or wine). She seemed annoyed we were there, it made me uncomfortable. Also the live music was annoying. 
You are better off going to the Marriott or Stones Throw. Very nice ambience and good service for the same price.

Haven't been here for awhile and my favorite meal was always chicken piccata so we decided to order that and asked for extra garlic bread and paid extra and never got any but they were quick to take the money though. Chicken piccata was fair I remember it being more " saucy" that's why we asked for the extra garlic bread we never got. Also asked for extra Parmesan and for two small containers. I don't know if I'll return ....

We used a buy one get one entree free coupon always printed in a tourist paper at the visitors center. We have been here several times and, despite being a touristy place, they serve good food. We started with the fried oysters. Very flavorful. I always get the smoked pork chop. Almost an inch thick, it is tender and tastes awesome. I wish they would served mixed roasted veggies with it instead of sauerkraut and mashed potatoes. Partner loved her turkey pot pie. It is a great place for visitors to get an authentic feel of colonial Phila. I wish that they would expand their beer selection and include a Yards IPA. Our server, Melina, was a real sweetheart who had to work the whole room by herself. She did a good job.

I'm sorry DiFabio's but you really let me down last night. I debated updating my review but I just need to warn others of this problem. I'm not quite sure why but we felt unwelcome drinking at the bar last evening. They cater to an older, upscale crowd. If you're under the age of 30, you'll probably get some rude looks by other bar patrons. It was a very uptight atmosphere for a Saturday night. It's sad because it's a beautiful bar and the food is fantastic.

. The drinks are also average to a little above average priced. I've had nothing but great experiences in the past. However, we felt judged for our age. It's something I've never experienced. We even overheard some guests thankful we were leaving. We weren't being overly obnoxious or loud. We stayed for one drink. Bartenders could tell we were upset. So we left. They assumed it was because of them. However,  it was the customers at the bar. Just not a good atmosphere and customers who act like they are better than you. It's not like it's a country club. It's just a nice taproom. Really sad.

I grew up on Greek food from Greektown in Detroit, so I love quality Greek food.  However, as I travel , more often than not, I'm disappointed at Greek restaurants.

I was NOT disappointed by Acropolis.  Excellent authentic Greek Food.  Huge portions and reasonable prices.  I highly recommend this place.

Service was OK but they were apparently short staffed.

We had Gyros, Greek Salad, Tabouli and Lemon Rice soup.  Everything was perfect.  Enjoy.

I am a Pho Connoisseur.  I have  Eaten the soup all over the Tampa Bay and this is by far the best place reminds me of the pho  I have eaten back home in Houston. I come to find out he has a restaurant out there also which would make sense as to why their pho is the best in Tampa Bay.

AMAZING!!! everything we tried (oysters, Calamari, chicken strips) was absolutely great and tasty!!! 
And the service.....was the best I've experienced in a very ling time, thank you Michelle, great job, I'll definitely be back!!!

So I really did not like this place. My party of 12 did not receive good service. We were not brought our bread and olive oil. We were hungry. It was overpriced for the bad service they provided us. Our service did not cash us out efficiently or effectively. I will not be coming back to this establishment

This place has an amazing location and the staff was exceptional! Very attentive and nice, plus followed all the covid guidelines. The menu was a bit odd and seemed random. We had a few sushi rolls and weren't impressed. It def lacked flavor. The lollipops were cute and tasty but they were very small! My husband and I usually can share 3 rolls and be full but we left a little hungry still.

Not good enough for the price. The fries are too thin and greasy and have an odd aftertaste. "Burger" patty was crunchy and burnt and again greasy. I should have known not to eat there when I saw that the drive thru was empty. Will not be returning. Once was more then enough.

Yummy biscuits and use the cotton bag to make a face mask .  On the inside of the mask, the recipe is a pocket to insert a filter , extra COVID-19 protection.
Jim & Nick's is not only an excellent source for comfort food...as we enjoy cheesy biscuits and MORE, the cotton fabric from their cheeses biscuit mix can be up-cycled

This place is terrible! The place smelled, the service was terrible, the food was not good at all. You can't advertise you have gluten free options when you do not. It's basically false advertisement when it says ask your server for gluten free options and the server and manager and everyone says we don't have anything but are leading towards that way. Our server seemed annoyed that she was even working. We had 4 ppl and all the food was mediocre. My husband got French toast that was plane Jane  looked like it was made from wonder bread aNd could be done at home- what a rip off! Not worth the wait at all!

Solid restaurant. 
One of the prettiest rooms with such great attention to minor detail. 
Service staff was knowledgeable and attentive. 
We ordered the Cured Scallop, Tuna Crudo, Sourdough Boule, Fluke, Duck, Panna Cotta, and Strawberry Shortcake. All were seasoned perfectly, and plated beautifully. The portions were great (two of us ordered six dishes, through three courses, ate them all and were not overfull--the way a meal should be served) and priced accordingly. 

Thank you.

Ooooo boy. Best food I've had in St Pete or Tampa. I strongly recommend the Simone and the toasted croissant with Brie and pear. Pastries were also par excellence. 

Pleasant and helpful operation, shout-out Marie. 

We made the drive over from Tampa and it was one of the best decisions we made all weekend. 

Convenient parking. And the right amount of COVID safety.

We went to Beefs tonight with the family and was very disappointed to say we will not be coming back. The waitress sat down and went over the different types of wings and how they are cooked. My daughter ordered all flaps and extra crispy and the rest of the family ordered regular wings and extra crispy. To our disappointment they came out All drums and not crispy at all. We sent them back for that is not what we ordered at all. No sorry or hey let's comp your meal for we messed up your order; they were going to give us the corrected order to take home but changed their mind at the end, so we paid for our beer and appetizers and called it a night. Guess we will be looking for a new wing place to call our home. My husband loves Beefs but this really pissed him off.

So they are extremely busy so plan on waiting. We decided to sit outside because there was a table that was open. Our waiter was amazing, really help our decision in what I could order and make vegan. I had the spaghetti and it was good, not the best but certainly not the worse I have had. I did find it a bit ridiculous that they charge an extra 3 bucks for the Daiya cheese when it comes with mozzarella cheese and I was asking to substitute it. They do have it on the menu that it's 3 bucks but I thought it would be for the pizza. Also the amount the lay on the pasta is not worth 3 bucks. The bread was amazing and honestly what won me over was the vegan cinnamon rolls, they were absolutely amazing. I could go back just for that. 
I will give them another try and maybe try the pizza this time.
One of the best fried fish places in STL! & it's black owned! Their hours do change sometimes so I always call ahead
Man, this was one great pizza! Whoa, Nellie!! No shortage of toppings, huge size, good value for the buck.
Omg so glad we stopped here. The ribs were amazing! The Brussels sprouts with pork belly were to die for. And the bacon Mac and cheese was killer. Great atmosphere and even better food!

Not very good considering the rave reviews.  The satay chicken was dry tough and not flavorful. The green curry was not flavorful nor did it look appealing. Same with the red curry. The only positive was that the chicken in the curry was tender.  No taste difference from green to red.

So I am giving Nino's a 3 star rating because the food was prepared to satisfaction however I was unimpressed with the pizza. I was never impressed before the new owners took over but now I am even more unlikely to get pizza from here again. The fries were nice and crisp. The ceasar salad was good.

My husband and I have been craving Chicago deep dish pizza. With no plans to travel to Chicago anytime soon, we decided to order some carryout pizzas from Chicago Pizza in McCordsville.

We ended up ordering a small deep dish pizza. It was their signature pizza called 'the hurt', double pepperoni. A small comes with 8 slices, about $12, and feeds 2 to 3 people. 

There was also a lot of boasting about the "world famous bread sticks" so we decided to give them a try as well.

The pizza was really good. I still haven't found any Indy pizza chains that really make a true deep dish. They all just seem to be almost a deep dish, like if a deep dish and a personal pan pizza had a baby. Usually one slice of a real deep dish can feel me up because it's loaded with toppings on an even thicker and more filling crust. Although this was not really the case for the deep dish at Chicago's, it was a very tasty pizza. The sauce was tart without being too overpowering and the crust was fluffy and good.

The bread sticks, those I would definitely say earn a title for being world famous! They don't look like much, but they pack so much flavor. We chose the nacho cheese sauce to accompany the bread sticks and did not regret it.

I'm interested to go back on a Wednesday and try the buffet I've heard about. Will definitely visit again.

This is probably the worst service I have ever gotten at any sonic. I am overall disappointed on the friendliness of the workers and the wait it took to get my food. The first time I had went here, it took nearly 15 minutes to make an order of the yummy cinna-snacks, where nearly no other customer was in sight. Why'd it take so long??? The second time I went there, the ice cream machine was broken and they weren't serving any milkshakes or cookie sandwiches. Upon telling my order to the worker, my friend was immediately cut off by "Our ice cream machine is down", before even finishing his order. (I'm sorry, did I just pull into a damn McDonald's ???). Overall, this sonic is a disappointment. I love sonic in general, there corndogs are out of this world, but this location is a complete disappointment. #neveragain
The hostess was beyond rude and my husband and I found out Stacy had been let go. We didn't even want to give them our money again. Decided to go somewhere else.

Has been in business ever since the mall was here, located in a central prime spot right in the center of all popular shops. Menu items mainly Italian but mixed of American type dishes and Asian type dishes

Recommend getting their Polynesian shrimp, delicious! Huge and comes in 8, appetizing and great to look at too. I also recommend the Asian pot stickers, the fried pot stickers were not oily but crisp and delicious. However I wouldn't recommend the steak Caesar salad, price of $18 gets you tasting almost dry hard to chew flank steaks... not worth it, should have tried the chicken one instead.

Always smells good when walking by, gets your mouth watering, definitely try it out!
Slowest chick fil a I've very been to. It took 20 minutes to get 2 sandwiches and 2 hash browns. And all workers were just standing around. Beware if you come here
I hate to write a bad review but the portion of noodles I got was way too small. I ordered the Jajangmyeon to go. It was absolutely delicious just too small.

Great spot for outstanding food. Best Italian food in the area. Wide variety of choices give everyone something for their taste. Excellent friendly service and fair prices. Another plus is that the owner is from my hometown, Yonkers. The only thing stopping a 5 star rating is that the red wines are all too warm. When I remember, I call ahead and ask for them to put the wine I will order in the fridge until I get there.Try it, you'll like it!

Excellent Mexican cuisine is a true find in New Orleans. Beautifully plated, creative entrees pleased the four of us. Our waitress was knowledgeable and offered suggestions for us to taste.
However, the staff did not clean tables around us, leaving dirty dishes for 30 minutes. This great find withered under a staff that needs more training on turning tables

This is my third time here and it was definitely better then the last time my boyfriend and I came. The drinks were really good and so was the food. It was nice to be back and the outdoor dining was really nice. We got dessert also the chocolate cake was delicious and apple cinnamon churro's were really tasty but I was disappointment because we got it to go and the churros were supposed to come with ice cream and there was none in the container...whomp whomp...overall we were pleased with our meals
What a gem ! One of the best impossible burgers I've ever had . Service is outstanding and it's kids friendly

Wonderful food. Nicest people you will ever find. Place is very clean and staff is exterior professional.  The creative menu and variety also keeps us coming back.  This place is so efficiently run that a wait time is nothing to worry about.

Ordered avocado toast and americano! 
Total was $22. And I agree with that price: 
When you can put to my package for take out enough napkins. When your toast which coast $14 (Williamsburg price in famous places) Same with toast for $7-8 , please tell me guys, how you moderate your prices? I think reason for the high price is your expensive rent which you pay . 
People, my reviews 95% only 5 stars or 4. 
But I hate places where people make high price just because they location is fancy and expensive. 
Kitchen in Honey and Milk can have only 1 star!

I came to Amada for lunch during restaurant week and it's certainly a steal! The restaurant does a great job at adhering to COVID measures. The staff are always wearing masks and gloves and the menu is accessible via QR code. The tables are pretty spaced out, but since it's outdoors there's limited seating. Make sure to have a reservation beforehand! 

I'd recommend coming for lunch during restaurant week; it's $20 in comparison to $35 for dinner. Amada is a Spanish tapas restaurant and you choose one appetizer, two entrees, and one dessert from a prix fix menu. The menu is pretty extensive and if you come with a group of people, my suggestion is to order a bunch of different tapas so you can try more dishes!

I got the Pimientos de Padrón, Entrecôte (hanger steak), Prawns, and the Pasteles de Chocolate (chocolate cream puffs). If you're a fan of green peppers, you'll love the Pimientos de Padrón. The Entrecôte and Prawns were small portions but both tasted so fresh. The cream puffs weren't mind blowing but I enjoyed them. My friends got the cheesecake and I'd recommend that over the cream puffs. 

TLDR: Great service, friendly staff, and very fresh tapas styled food that makes for a fun meal.
We just ordered a taco and they literally dropped the taco in upside down, not even wrapped.

Food was okay. The server, Scott, was so annoying. He kept coming to our table like he was waiting for us to leave. He then brought the check when we were only half way through with our food. I wanted dessert so thanks for assuming we were done. After he brought the check (and we're still eating) he came 5 times after to see if we were done!! Oh my god! We just said never mind and left. No tip because you pushed us to the point of leaving. Will never be back to this location!

I came I saw I ate. That's literally I have for this place I came with my family for birthday dinner and we had a HUGE party I was late so I can a corner seat and found out they only sit parties when the entire group is there bummer. Besides that our waiter was pretty good he took everybody's order in a timely fashion they said. When I got there he came straight to me to get mine I was a little indecisive I wanted the jambalaya rolls but something in my gut told me not to get it. So I went with the shrimp and corn chowder. And it was PERFECT man all I needed was a little bread to make it perfect. I only got the bowl and it was more than enough halfway thru I was full overall I wouldn't recommend them for large groups. The staff they had brought out the food couldn't tell us what certain things were so we were left guessing and trying each other dish to see who it belonged to.

Came here on a Thursday evening upon the recommendation of friends. During COVID, tables have been placed on the sidewalk surrounding the restaurant and social distancing guidelines are adhered to. Don't forget that Audrey Claire is a BYOB so make sure to bring your favorite bottle fo wine to accompany the meal!

Their menu is a 4 course pre fixe for $45 which is very reasonable and you'll leave quite full. To start they serve a summer tomato gazpacho. Gazpachos in general just aren't my favorite, but my friend thought it was a bright and refreshing start to the meal. For the second course, we tried the whipped ricotta and the beet salad. The whipped ricotta was such a hit - served with warm pita bread and some spring peas & fava beans, we ate it right up. For the entree, we tried the seared scallops and the maple brined pork chop. The scallops were cooked perfectly and I really enjoyed the spicy brussel sprouts served with it. The pork chop was interesting and had a distinct sweet maple taste, but overall I thought it was a bit dry. Finally, for dessert we both had the tahini crusted chocolate truffles which were a nice sweet bite to the end of the meal. 

Overall, I found the meal interesting and a good value for the price. A few dishes had room for improvement, but overall was quite good. I'd recommend for a nice night out with friends.

Definitely loved this place ! I heard about this gem when moving to Fl recently . The staff is very welcoming . Because of Covid, there is only one entrance and I think it's cool that you get to see the cooks preparing the food as you walk through the restaurant. . The drinks are everything I was told they were, STRONG! Whoa the cilantro jalapeno margarita! Whew, delicious ! I'm super glad that I got a smaller portion of the burrito bc i was def full !

My roommate and I went in this morning for brunch and had a great experience. We had Sebastian as our waiter l, or Sebas as his name tag read, and he was awesome. He was super nice and was very good about helping us with whatever we needed including keeping our mimosas filled! Had the Mexico City omelet and it was soooo good. Definitely a great start to our Sunday
Tandoori Chicken Poutini was , the curry was very flavorful and was not salty like some other places. I was very pleased with the food and service.

This was my first time trying the food here through a company event. My first impression was not that great being that on their menu it says they deliver, but when we called the person on the phone stated that they don't deliver and that is just written on the advertisement. Well that's kind of false advertisement right? So at the last minute we had to send someone to go and pickup our order. I had the caffe turkey club sandwich on a croissant and it was ok in terms of club sandwiches. The dressing was only on half of the sandwich but the turkey tasted good. The bacon was slightly soggy as well. I also had a chocolate chip cookie which was hard but I'm assuming that's how their cookies are supposed to be. Overall just a mediocre experience for me. Perhaps I'll try again eating in and see if I have a better experience.
The staff is so friendly and the food was incredible! Everything was super fresh and portions were great too!

Shoutout to Mack for treating me so special for my Birthday!!! She showed me all the pastry choices describing each one in detail at my request. She took the time to make sure I'd be happy with my choice & her helpful suggestions were spot on! Thanks Mack for great personalized service!

We drove by and decided to stop and try this little place. They were appropriately taking precautions due to covid. Upon walking in the smell was delightful. 

I ordered the spicy bulgogi while my husband ordered the regular bulgogi.

So flavorful!!! The grilled onions had soaked up at the sauce from the meat and were so tasty. It wasn't too spicy and definitely had more flavor than the regular meat. Rice was the perfect level of sticky making it easy to eat with chopsticks. I would definitely return! I would like to try the ramen next.
In my opinion, for what it's worth, their spicy ramen is the best. It has a great kick, but is also balanced in the creamy broth. Love it!
This place is so New Orleans! Excellent food and a great vibe combine to make it an experience not to be missed! Bartenders Brittany and Jordan are excellent and work to please.

What a great experience we had here! Excellent service and great food. Best fritto misto I've ever had. Oh, yes, and the wine! Great selection. I'm glad well-behaved kids were welcomed. No one seemed to frown that my 9 year old was with us (a couple of other older kids were there too). The courtyard patio was very charming. We'll be back!

Great all around, the Thanksgiving Pre-Fix meal was great. Super easy to work with and great variety.

Christmas Day was also super easy and well done.
Thank you for being open for being during the holidays, made my life easier. 

 Keep up the great work!


MR. B

My carry out order was ready on time and still warm when I got home.  However, they forgot to include the warm tortillas with my order and what they call "steak" is unlike any meat I've ever seen.  Very average tasting food, nothing special.

I finally tried this restaurant out on a beautiful Sunday afternoon when it was in the 70's with the sun popping in and out behind the clouds. The outdoor seating was perfect and they were playing somewhat loud music from another establishment across the way, which livened up the atmosphere.  

My friend and I started with the Guacamole appetizer that's served with sweet potato chips. It was delicious, but if you are avoiding soy for any reason then you should know that the chips are cooked in soy oil. For lunch, I enjoyed the #1 Tuna Salad.  The tuna was drizzled with an aioli sauce, which on it's own is so flavorful that it satisfies as is. However, the ginger salad was refreshing, delightful, and a nice combo. I would come back just for this.  My friend ordered some sort of Turkey Sandwich with Sweet Potato Fries. She's a very picky eater and made comments about her skepticism of going to a restaurant where she's not familiar with the food.  Think... chronic American chain restaurant customer that sticks to "safe" food that the pickiest children would eat.  Haha. With that said, she said her entree was very good.  So that's saying something... even though she chose a sandwich and sweet potato fries.

I will definitely be back again on Sunday again, but would also like to try during weeknight happy hour.

Good, reliable cheesesteak with no frills plus delicious French fries. A little out of the way for a tourist, but worth the trip. I was worried about the COVID set-up and the hot peppers but thankfully they give it to you in a plastic bag. I'll always come here when I'm in Philly.

Service was great. Good came out in a good amount of time. Everything we ate was so good and seasoned to perfection. The oysters morrow and sesame wings were the best. The bread pudding was sent from heaven above.

This place has horrible service and not much better food. Stopped in to get something, waited to be seated but no one bothered. Decided to go for takeout and the cashier (who wasn't busy) couldn't be bothered to answer a few questions. She acted like I was a nuisance and she'd rather have a Chinese patron. They have limited selection of dim sum. There are much better, and welcoming places to go.

This place is my shit. It delivers further than a lot of others and their food is always fresh and super delicious. Best thing was the spicy stir fried vermicelli shrimp, and the egg rolls. Best place for a good price. Can't wait to actually visit.

We were looking for an outside patio to dine. Large patio and we were the only guest at the time to utilizing the patio. Nice location between the buildings so there was a nice breeze and no direct sun. Wonderful service and the meal met expectations. Nice place to go for a date night

We loved the atmosphere, even if the restaurant was small. The waitress's was awesome, a complete love. I had the spinach omelette with potatoes and my boyfriend had the western omelet with potatoes. My omelette was stuffed with spinach and cheese. I had to pull out some of the spinach because I'm not THAT healthy! We got two buttered up slices of sourdough and coffee, which was good, and enjoyed the music and family atmosphere. They have tables and also a bar, that had biker dudes on them talking to a group of young kids. It was a good breakfast. Nothing fancy, more like food at mom's. We ended up taking leftovers home. They have a good amount of parking, but it's really small in there, so go early! By 930 (Saturday), when we left, there were people waiting outside to go in. We liked it there and will be back!

One of Tampa's best restaurants. Oak and Ola is modern American-Euro. The pizza is to die for especially the mushroom truffle pizza. Perfect crust and the mushrooms were super flavorful. For dinner I had the 16 oz pork chop it was Sous Vide , it was cooked absolutely perfect, succulent , thanksgiving like. My wife had the lobster pasta-and she was extremely happy with it as well, tasted homemade. Will return soon, can't go wrong with any of this groups restaurants between On Swann , Olivia and this -it's the best dining in the city.

I got a postmates for this place. Ive been vegan gluten free for 30 years and for some reason I'd never been here.  I got several calls from the kitchen along about my allergies.  How amazing.  To define safety in your communities health and ensure culinary skills is so awesome.  The broccoli is the freshest ive seen in years.  My snap peas,  my tofu cuts soooo impressed.  My new favorite.  Omg, I want more

Meh.

Service was good - sadly, not good enough to overcome the pricey mediocrity of the food.   

Oysters - $4 apiece.....they were cooked to a rubber chicken quality.   One of my dining companions had a dozen of the raw.  He liked them but, referred to the order as a $50 dozen.

Salads were ok....just ok.

The steak sliders were also just "ok".

Seems like a good place to go for drinks but, would not recommend for food.

I have gone to Couch Tomato many times and always love the food and how it's prepared. The staff is very helpful and understanding, especially Anna who served me last time I went in. I am just so upset at the pride flags being taken down. As an ally of the LGBTQ+ community I highly suggest putting them back up and not listening to small minded, ignorant people who correspond pride to an opinion on sodomy... it's celebrating those who spent centuries hiding in the shadows and their victory at Washington on June 26th.

We were seated outside (were not given an option for inside). The ducks will fly up on the railing and shake lake water all over your food and your guests if you are seated by the railing in the outside area. Some may enjoy that and we didn't mind the wild life. The issue is too many people have been feeding these guys. I asked to speak with the manager. Some little douche came over and simply told us "that's the risk you take sitting outside".  No alternate table, no "let me see what I can do", just a simple shut up and suck it up attitude. The "manager" is Dakota. 

The food is good and we like this place. The management training on customer service is pathetic.  Keep that in mind when you go here.

Great food
Great drink
like the live music
bar service was Awesome
good drinks
Reasonable $$
No parking

will be going back

Phil from Philly
The service is very slow; we finally got our appetizers but they didn't even give us silverware to eat it with. They rarely checked up on us but were serving every other table.

This was a lot of fun. Went for a girls night out. The drinks were delicious and strong. I got the Fancy AF, it was brought out in a bell jar and was smoking. Don't go hungry, the food is really just snack/tapas plates. Atmosphere is very nice. Would make for an awesome intimate date night.

Really really good Salvadoran food! I ordered the churrasco Salvadoreño and wow it was just so delicious.  The meat was flavorful and the rice and beans were probably some of the best I've tried in a while. My family ordered a few other different dishes and they all really enjoyed the food. 
The actual restaurant is pretty small but don't let that deter you from checking it out. It was a nice evening when we went so we decided to eat outside. They have like 2 or 3 tables on the side of the restaurant which was perfect for us. 
The reason their not getting 5 stars is because the waitress kept forgetting stuff (tortillas, straws, lemon, etc.) She was really nice though, I just think she might have been new but not sure. Other than that, this place has really good food and is a must whenever in Philly.

Came in for lunch with a party of 3 for the first time. Ended up ordering a bento box which came with vegetable tempura and chicken and shrimp tempura. It was a nice size box with many different items. 

The bento box also came with with 2 sushi rolls and I ended up getting some extra rolls for the table. Everything tasted so good and was fresh. The customer service was great and the service was fast. 

The menu is huge and there's so many items to choose. My aunt had the hibachi because shes not a fan of sushi, and she was raving about how delicious it tasted.
This place is a joke,If you have no taste buds this is a please sandwich is more bread then anything more lettuce than bread. Total crap

My husband and I are in town celebrating my birthday and read some great reviews about Gris Gris so we checked it out on our first night in town; this place did NOT disappoint! WOW! Our server, Trey also happened to be a California native and was extremely helpful, informative and just great to talk to! Head chef, Chris was on hand to answer any questions, referred some great spots to grocery shop and even gave us a little side dish of Chicharrones to snack on. We loved it so much we're planning on going back before we leave just to say hi to everyone and grab a glass of their delicious sangria! On top of the excellent service and great food, Gris Gris had a casual, yet high end vibe without the pretentious attitude. If you're looking for laid back, quality atmosphere with great food and drink, then Gris Gris is your stop!
Had the cold brew coffee here three days in a row! Very good! Nice place that wasn't busy around 7am.

I tried Thai Basil in Meridian once and fell in love with their Thai food.  I have been looking for another good Thai restaurant closer to where I live but no luck.  I was very excited when I heard about this new location in SE Boise.

Since it's located in a descent size shopping center, parking is not a problem.  Staff members are friendly and helpful as always.  I tried their Thai Basil Noodle Duck because I love ducks.

First, they have me a complimentary bowl of soup which is soupy rice porridge,  but it was really good.

The noodle is light sauced chow-mein like with bell peppers, onion, basil and ducks.  The veggies were very fresh so you can taste the sweetness of them, among with the aroma of basil.  Duck is a bit dryer than I expected but still very delicious.  

I am ready to go back to try more dishes they offer.  I am happy to see this gem is here in Boise!

We ate here for breakfast, and the breakfast was good the seafood omelette and alligator omelette we're both very good. Right on the hash browns, and only one slice of toast but for the area a good breakfast for a good price. They advertise their Fried Chicken to be so great, so we decided that we would try that as well, a different meal obviously. The Fried Chicken was semi spicy it was overcooked the green beans had some weird taste in them the french fries which we asked for specifically extra crispy were limp and we did not even eat them. As far as service, the young man that waited on us was flat as a pancake, couldn't even get him to smile, he did check on us so he was attentive but had no business being a waiter.
Mac and cheese was excellent, but the Hangar steak was just okay. The service was excellent which definitely made the experience.
This place has excellent food and great service. I have never had something here that I did not enjoy thoroughly. If you are looking for some quality Chinese food, this is a great place to go.

El P is exactly what you want from a mexican restaurant. are you gonna get on yelp and rave about how innovative the taco options are, how elevated the menu is, how modern the decor? nope. but you know what? the sangria ain't overly sweet, margs are big, the chips and salsa never end, and everything is covered in cheese. what else did you want? 
well good news, bud, because what else you got is the most comprehensive tequila bar you've ever seen. yeah, for real, better than anywhere, i've checked. and chris and hector know what's up.

Today, open only for to go, catering orders due to CV. Don't have time to give it a long review. 

Service was spot on, food freshly prepared, their recipes are excellent and the cook did a fantastic job 

Facility v clean, nice branding

This group will see great growth over the coming years
They didn't have a large menu option due to covid however they're service was very good and the drinks were STRONG just how we like them.

We entertained out of town family at The Waterwheel Tavern last Saturday, we wanted to patron a local restaurant.  We were sadly  embarrassed by the decline in the quality of their food!  We ordered Surf and Turf kabobs which consisted of dried out shrimp skewers sitting atop a plateful of tasteless overcooked French fries.  For $26 we expected more.  The steak was nowhere to be found! The scallops for $30 a plate were also disappointing.  We spent $190 for the meal and it was beyond disappointing.
Literally my favorite place to eat. The food quality, affordable price, friendly service, chill vibe and constantly incredible music selections make it an overall ideal dining experience.

A group of (6) went to visit this establishment on June 1st right after their Saturday Brunch rush around 3:30pm. The restaurant was very slow and there was around 4 servers not doing much. 

We asked to be sat outside in a booth. The host was hesitant to sit us because we just wanted to drink rather than eat. Most likely we would have ordered food anyways. 

As we were sat the host told us our server will be right with us. Mind you a handful kept passing by. After 10 minutes of waiting we went to the bartender and asked for a server. She said "you have to ask your host". First, rude. Second, we were sat by the host. 

After waiting another 15 minutes we decided to leave. From the moment we walked in we felt unwelcome. We should have known since the host was very hesitant to sit us since we weren't eating. 

Prior, 4 of our group members had already gone to brunch their in the morning, left and then came back when it was slower to be able to sit outside when it slowed down. 

As we left the host (not the one that originally greeted us) was apologetic, however the bouncer was defensive and asked "well were you seated by a host or did you just sit." The funny thing was he was there when we were sat by the host. 

Overall bad service, and if you're not a college kid you seem to be dismissed. Which is very sad since our group is well in our 30s, established business professional, and doctors, who would probably spend way more then the average college student that attends this loc

The photo explains everything. We went out for Korean bbq as a family and boy oh boy did we eat. They were very accommodating as we don't eat pork so they substituted it for chicken. Everything was sooooo good and it was fun grilling the meats to our desired liking. We also had two bottles of Korean rice wine Shoju I believe it was called and it was like a light vodka, very smooth. The service was so exceptional as well. We enjoyed it very much!
the meal was so bad that if I gave it to my dog he would have to lick his ass to get the taste out his mouth.

This is a cute little French cafe that was conveniently located by my hotel. Breakfast croissant included eggs and your choice of meat (I chose bacon). According to my receipt, the cheese cost $0.60 extra. It was ok - better than many office cafes but far from some of the better French food than I've had in Paris and LA. The croissant was on the bready side (as opposed to the light flakiness I crave in a croissant), and the eggs were dense instead of fluffy and clearly not made with high-quality farmers market eggs (I know, I know, I'm so spoiled). The bacon was actually quite good but there was hardly any of it. The latte was good too. Didn't get a chance to try any of their pastries on this trip.

Came here for my grandmother's birthday, and had a great time. Overall good service and good food. 

The interior decor has an old-Church vibe. I'd safely say this place would not be considered casual, but also not upscale either. It's a nice place to host large events, and reminds me of a place that the Italian mafia would dine. It feels old, yet beautiful, casual, but still fancy - basically a great place to celebrate any grandmother's birthday. 

Our waiter was extremely nice. Orders came in pretty fast, and he was very accommodating in explanations. The tables are extremely close together so there were some random pushes and pulls coming from the wait staff to get through, but nothing too bothersome. 

For appetizers, we ordered both the truffle and zucchini fries. Both were great, although the truffle on the truffle fries were a bit overpowering. I'd definitely recommend the zucchini fries over the truffle ones, but I also really enjoyed the truffle fries as well. 

We got a bottle of Riesling too. It was $26, which I thought was not too bad. They have a pretty large list of wines, which is nice, since they're also a BYOB place. We unfortunately completely forgot to bring wine, so it was nice to see that they had a lot of choices available on hand. 

In terms of food, my mom and I both ordered the scallop risotto and it was GREAT. Its a bit on the salty side, but otherwise, I'd say this dish was perfect. Honestly, this is the first time I've seen my mom finish a dish in

I have been coming here since it opened.  I've had the benefit of living all around the world and enjoying some fantastic food. The Asian Kitchen is amazing. It keeps the high pointS of the food and adds a bit of fusion thaT takes it to the  next level. The service is fast and the location allows for minimal traffic. I highly recommend this place for foodies or those that just want a throughly enjoyable meal.
A fusion of styles with a farm to table setting = awsomeness made up of unique tastes.

The entrées were very good! The staff was very friendly except for the server that was behind the bar today which is April 13, 2019 what's my first time going I had chicken and dumplings my daughter have fried chickenThey were both very delicious red velvet cake awesome the price is fair and I will be returning!!!

We love this place. Came for the first time last year when we were in town for a conference. It was so good we came twice that trip. It was on our list to return this year when we came for the same conference. This place is consistently outstanding. Staff is friendly and food is top notch. Everything we have ordered is delicious.

Terrible! I used to eat here all the time and the food, drinks, and atmosphere were awesome. Now that the Cheesecake Factory bought Fox restaurants, the quality has gone down immensely. I am pretty easy to please with tacos, but I couldn't even eat these. I ordered the corn tortillas and they were like cardboard. The fillings were super dry (I ordered three different proteins) and flavorless. They are trying to save money and the quality is definitely suffering. If you want tacos, go anywhere but here.
Best Shrimp Tacos ever! The other BUS ain't got ish on this place!! Try the mexican fried potatoes! Wow! I used to eat these all the time growing up.

Showed up early for my food but told the guy it was no rush. Food was ready five minutes later. Get home 15 minutes later. My chow mein has noodle. I call and tell the guy this. He says, "Lo mein has noodles, chow mein doesn't". 

CHOW MEIN LITERALLY MEANS STIR FRIED NOODLES

Food was decent but seriously... utterly stupid to lie.

Went here thinking it was a top of the line steakhouse, and it was not. It was very loud, and bright. Our server was preoccupied with another large party, so he did not take care with my husband my small party of 2. Food was ok, though the crab cakes were tiny for the price.

I like it, but I don't love it. The happy hour prices are good, but the food is just okay. I've had the rice and beans bowl with grilled grouper, tacos, and fried chicken sandwich, and I haven't been blown away by anything. 

It's a cool, laid-back place to watch a game and convenient location if you live in Seminole Heights. I don't like the seating situation; it's first come, first serve so we were here on a busy night and there was a group of people standing over us waiting for us to leave so they could sit. Why not just have a hostess? 

I'll be back to support the neighborhood business, but I'd like to see tastier food and organized seating.

got the beef brisket with 2 sides (corn and coleslaw). The staff were nice and there was a line but it moved fast. The corn was the best tasting thing out of the plate! The brisket was good - but was a little too smoky for my liking (it's my personal taste though). The coleslaw was more of a pickle: it tasted vinegary and there was no mayonnaise: I liked the vinegar taste and it was refreshing given the fatty meat, but it doesn't taste like a coleslaw :)
Cutest little dining area with solid food and some of the nicest people on staff you've ever encountered. Always so pleasant to pop in here!

Stopped in after girl's day shopping, for lunch.  The place was pretty empty for a Saturday afternoon. But, maybe busier at night.  It was bright, clean, and welcoming.  Our waitress was friendly and made a few menu suggestions without being pushy. Food came quick, but waited for our drinks (not alcohol), which was strange. I had a very tasty Greek wrap, they came with homemade chips (get them!).  The chips were seriously delish!!  Someone at the table ordered a burger rare.... and it was rare!  She said most places won't do rare, so she was happy  all in all a pretty solid experience.  But next time let's get some hustle behind the drink order, okay?? Lol

I've only been here twice and had good experiences both times. Food tasted good (Wish i took pictures to upload). However, i was a bit disappointed when i ordered the Kung Pao Chicken. At many other places it has a good amount of vegetables mixed in with cubed chicken, however, here, the chicken was breaded, it kinda looked like chicken nuggets and very little vegetables. A bit disappointed at the quality of this dish. However, i do still recommend coming here for food. overall flavor is great and at the moment they do have a very wonderful contactless order pick up system! No dine-ins yet here.

The food was good, but the service was disappointing.  We stood in the restaurant for several minutes before calling them to let them know we were waiting for a table.  The (apparent) owner sprawled lazily with friends at a table across the restaurant while we sat with empty drinks waiting for the check.  We were made to feel like our presence was an inconvenience for the staff.  Maybe we caught them on an off night?

As a 23 year Combat vet (Combat Medic) fellow vets please beware of this place. I served honorably with 10 of those years on foreign land. I say all of that to say this as a former 1SG I can not in good faith not warn my fellow active duty and fellow vets. 

Liars, this was NOT a great experience.......On 17 June 2020 I visited this location while on vacation. After paying for my meal I left. A few minutes down the road I realized the waitress Amanda still had my card.  I called the restaurant told them Amanda still has my card.  I gave the person who answered the phone my Name for security purposes, the name of the credit card company,  the color of the card, what table I sat at, how many were in my party, and the amount. She then asked me was it a visa or mastercard?????? I simply asked do you have my credit card or not? so that I can call my bank and say that it was stolen or not. This person refused to even tell me if the card was there! They continued to give me a hard time to the point that I was forced to turn around and physically return to the restaurant.  When I got there I gave them my name and again asked for my card. It was given back to me immediately WITHOUT even checking my ID card or asking any questions.   I then proceeded to ask for a manager. I explained to him what his employee just did. He apologized but he missed the entire point. All the b.s on the phone but when I showed up in person the restaurant immediately handed over a credit card without asking

In a world against carbs, this place is worth the fight! Let me be clear, I'm straight up a carb lover. I once tried to be Whole 30...silly me! So when my mom read an article in the newspaper about Ceres, I kept plotting when I could get there! I started following Ceres on Instagram and dreaming of my pasta lunch to come! Today that dream of getting downtown and having fresh pasta with sauce came true! This place is definitely a fantastic addition to downtown Tucson! My husband and I enjoyed two different types of pasta with different sauces. We selected our sauces first... Bolognese and Cacio e pepe and then asked for help with selecting noodles that would best compliment our sauces. It's not the cheapest lunch dish you're going to find, but if you want real and hearty Italian, this has to be your joint. I can promise you won't do any better in Tucson. This was a pasta dish that satisfied for longer than a couple hours. There's a reason people say our store-bought pasta sucks. It does. This is clearly the way pasta should be enjoyed. Support the local ladies at Ceres and do yourself a favor. Pick up a bowl!

This was so good! Everyone liked everything. Rice ball was my favorite. We also had shrimp tacos, gangam taco, carne asada, chicken, banh mi & burger. All excellent!! And at a batting cage! Boys went 3 rounds. Great way to start a long trip!

Went with a group of 4 people. I ordered from lunch menu. Had wanton soup, chow rice and mongol beef. The broth had no flavor but the wanton in the soup was tasty. The chow rice had a few peas, a small amount of sliced carrots and 1 piece of scrambled egg.  Mongol beef was just ok. Loaded with white and green onions and a tiny sprinkle of white noodles. A member of group had Red Ramen soup. Very disappointing. No flavor. Not ramen noodles, more like spaghetti noodles. She asked for egg and she got a fried egg on top. However one person in group had salad and was happy that romaine lettuce was used and dressing was tasty, however nothing but lettuce and dressing. So as far as food was concerned the general feeling was that it's just ok. Probably won't go again. On the plus side: parking was good and wait staff was nice.

The service, location, atmosphere, food and coffee are all outstanding. The only thing that wasn't outstanding was the portion size of the biscuits and gravy, $8 for one biscuit was pretty weak, they could probably add another without risking the business going under.
However, the raspberry mocha is , so, take that into consideration.

Very home style cooking authentic none of that food from a jar crap. I usually order the green salsa carnitas well portioned even when it's to go corn tortillas yum! I also enjoy the papusas yum always hot. Well run place I hope they make it through the pandemic.

When you walk in it's overwhelming all the things to look at. I personally liked this about Pinocchio's. I feel they have a lot of character all over the walls. The host and waitress I had were so kind, and to top it off the food was so good. I will be back. The menu is honestly so big you can get something new every single time which I like, but am also slightly overwhelmed by.

I decided I wanted some good ol' miso soup, to kick off  #YelpsBigNightIn. On my search, I stumbled upon Sushi Boss. I hadn't tried this establishment before, so I thought it would be perfect to order from this local business. 

Well, I couldn't just order miso soup for delivery.. so I also added the cucumber salad and create your own 1/2 and 1/2 roll. 

The cucumber salad had a nice salt, sweet and tart taste to the English cucumbers. However, I didn't know that it was topped with what looks like peanuts . I don't recall seeing that on the online ordering system. 

The miso soup was a standard taste, as I was hoping for. There was nice chunks of tofu too!

The sushi is 1/2 shrimp tempura and 1/2 beef short ribs. I added asparagus, cream cheese, cucumber and mango. Weird combo? I don't know what I was thinking, but I created a masterpiece. The taste was AMAZING! 

The price for my meal was amazing too!

Sushi Boss: you have my future business

Used to be a really nice location. Service used to be great. It used to be clean. The restaurant smells weird- everything is sticky and the service is terrible. I was shocked to see how much this place has gone downhill. My daughter chose R.R. For her birthday dinner...because in the past the staff has been great- my 7 year old daughter told the hostess and our server it was her birthday and both acted as if they didn't care. The service during the meal was awful- and when it came time for dessert- our server didn't even ask if we wanted anything. In the past they celebrated with her and made her feel special- I almost felt like our server made a point to show how much she didn't care. It was horrible- we were upset when we left- she was in tears- and needless to say- next year we are going somewhere else.  Service is more that taking the food from the kitchen to the table- and if you can treat a seven year old like that on their birthday- than you need to find a new line of work because customer service is NOT for you. Like seriously? Who acts like that?! That is so sad to me. I hope that management/ corporate is able to help this location recover.
Best Vietnamese in the area. Hasn't disappointed in over a decade! Quality meals and great service.

While Indian buffets aren't my first choice for consuming Indian food, this was a good one. 

We came for lunch and everything was very fast. You sit down, go to the buffet, and pay at the register when you're ready to leave. 

I enjoyed the food. My favorites were the chicken 555 and the pepper chicken, but there were many other things I enjoyed as well. 

It's hard to beat the price as well. I think it was $11 or $12 for an all you can eat buffet. 

If you like Indian buffets, you should definitely come here for lunch.

They were out of steak, so no steak & eggs.  They were out of Turkey bacon & Turkey sausage, so I had the Lobster Eggs Benedict.  On a scale of 1-10, I rate it an 8.  It had great flavor & the potatoes & fruit that came with it were tasty too.

Do not come here if you're expecting to spend $12 on lunch. This is a very healthy and hearty sandwich.  It's not cheap though. But you will get a very high-quality sandwich and one can easily tell that the products they use in the sandwich are high-quality. 

I used to work in a delicatessen when I was a kid and I can tell that the meats here at Jersey Mikes are either Boar's Head  or it's contemporary-equivalent. 

Take a look at the photographs I've attached. 

If you want cheap, go to Subway but if you want a quality sandwich, eat here. 

This place  reminds me of a New York Italian deli!
We are Westchase residents and completely love it here. Great food and family atmosphere. Always a good time!

We have eaten here a lot, and our initial impression has been extremely positive.   The food and coffee drinks have been absolutely wonderful.

Our opinion has declined recently.   One problem I have is that they refuse to allow substitutions.   I've asked on 2 different occasions, and both times they said no.   For example, I asked to substitute a croissant for toast, and they refused.   I would expect an upcharge of course, but they just flat out said "No"!   I've never experienced this sort of thing.   In fact, I'm writing this review at Illinois Street Food Emporium, where that's exactly what I just did - asked for a croissant to substitute for my toast.   No problem, just $2 extra.

I'm now wondering if that is just the tip of a snobbish attitude here.   We went a few days ago and asked for a booth, and a heavy-set woman gave us a condescending look, as in "how dare you inconvenience us to clear out a separate table for you".    At least that's how it came across.

If it were only for these things, I wouldn't be giving this place a 1-star rating.   What happened recently to my brother-in-law just blew my mind!   He ate there recently and accidentally brought in a Monster drink.   They had this same heavy-set woman serving them.   She made this dramatic gesture about it, not at all congenial.  He apologized and took the drink back to his truck.

I am told by his sister-in-law (who is sitting at the table with me as I write this, and who was at the table with them) that th

We've been to Masala Spice twice now and while the food and atmosphere are good, the service was very bad. Our rice and naan came 30 minutes before our main dish and was cold. Our server noted this and said he'd bring out a new order of rice and naan, but it never came.   Similar bad experience the first visit.  Wanted to like this place but won't be coming back.
First time coming here, excellent food, excellent service, love the guy with the mustache. 10/10

Awesome coffee. Surprise with a variety of drinks offered. 
Staff was very friendly and answered all my questions - I had a few. ;)
Very reasonable prices.

Open for takeout and delivery. A very good place and the food is great. My wife and I ordered a Gyro Salad with extra Gyro on the side. Only took them 10 minutes but me longer to drive up there. Salad was very large and the Gyro meat came in two large boxes. Less than $19 for everything including the tzatziki sauce, two sides of salad dressing and a bunch of pits bread. Great meal.
Soooo good! I always get the veggie burger on pretzel bun with their spicy ketchup and garlic fries! Worth trying and definitely worth coming back!

Made reservations and upon arrival they only offered us outdoor seating.  Parking was next to impossible.  Music was so loud you couldn't hear your conversation with someone across the table from you.  Will not be returning.

The first time I ordered, there was way too much cheese on the pizza. I thought it was a mistake. I was wrong.... Our pizza had so much cheese that we couldn't even eat it. It was disgusting! Wings were good.

The best pizza in Mount Juliet, hands down! 

We've eaten here pre-COVID and now during COVID and they haven't lost a step. We ordered a pizza for delivery via their website, it was super easy and arrived on time. They even offer contactless delivery! 

We ordered two 12-inch pizzas and garlic knots. A chicken pesto pie and mushroom Asiago. The pesto pie was exploding with flavor, the pesto and basil combination was delicious. The mushroom pizza was a great contrasts to the booming flavors of the pesto pizza. The Mushroom flavor was subtle and the asiago added a nice salty funk that comes with great cheese. Garlic knots... butter, bread, garlic chunks - what's not to love?! 

The total for all of this was $45, which is an amazing price for two brick oven craft pizzas and garlic knots. Calabria will be our go to spot for pizza from now on!

Are there last night with my family and it was amazing.  The atmosphere was fun, relaxing and surprisingly quiet as many restaurants like this are so loud that it can sometimes be challenging to hear the person across the table from you even during COVID.  The food is amazing and their drink is fun and everyone enjoyed finding their favorite one!  What is even better is that most places that have custom drinks usually don't have great options for beer, bourbon/whiskey or wine options but nope again stellar options that did not disappoint. 

The food was awesome and our server made great recommendations and everyone loved what they ordered and tasted of each other's. Service was great 

Recommend without hesitation.  And I know my grandson would love their Mac n cheese recipe.

The inside is beautiful and an iconic place. We haven't been since it reopened but we have always considered it a quintessential New Orleans dining experience. The food at this new Brennan's is disgusting. The only link or nod to Nola was gumbo and turtle soup. My husband had the turtle soup and asked me to try it...tasted like burned broth. The menu featured things like sweetbreads, rabbit, octopus Etouffee...do we eat octopus Etouffee here? From the wilted and sour salad to the entrees and even dessert nothing was enjoyable. The only part that could be considered stellar was the service. Such attention to detail except for when the waiter poured our bottled spring water in the glasses of the neighboring table. Overall a disappointing experience.
I have been here more there more than a few times-the SPECIALS-are always spot on and the wings-are outta this world good. They have a super pizza
This is hands down the best sandwich I've had outside the city. Porchetta and cutlet sandwiches are next level. Staff is great .

We decided not to go in. Just as we were walking in, an employee (or should I say ex-employee) stormed out saying he quit, because none of the kitchen staff will wear a mask. 

We wear our masks and Cracker Barrel employees should be doing the same for everyone's safety.

We had dinner last night, the check was $160, added $30 for tip.  The meal was worth $80, including the glass of Merlot and watered down vodka rocks. The service was very good, the ribeye steak I had was cooked to order, rare, but had too much connective tissue in it. My wife's filet was cooked correctly but not good meat.  The au gratin potatoes looked like they were from a bag of frozen, cubed potatoes, not up to expectations. The creamed spinach was mediocre. Sorry, a real disappointment, returning to Bern's much better value. We won't be back.
I could write a paragraph talking about how bad this place is run but I know it won't do anything so just a WARNING DO NOT EAT HERE. Drive to a different McDonald's.
Yes so much yes that this is open again.   Not quite the same set up as the former Papa Roux but still just as delicious.    Staff is awesome.  Food is excellent.
This is my first time ordering breakfast for delivery. My oders was incomplete, nasty, along with a breakfast platter missing. I will not be ordering again.

The best restaurant in Algiers hands down! Loved this small place, it has such a homey vibe to it. The menu was amazing, I ordered the spicy cajun pasta, the pizza bites, and a cheese pizza. Everything was so delicious, and the food came out super quick and hot! The service was awesome as well, this is definitely my new go to spot.
I decided to eat here, and It wasn't bad, however I just got French toast. Everything here was a little too eccentric.

I was hungry for something good the other night and I was by the Reading Terminal, which is full of great places to eat.  It was ~5:35 PM and some places had shut down already since the terminal closes at 6.   I walked frantically and quickly, then found Hunger Burger-- wheat a great find. I had the Philbert Burger that has AC, applewood smoked bacon lettuce, tomato and their burger sauce-- it was awesome!  I did not want to put down this juicy and delicious burger.  I had a side of the fries, which were a crinkle cut with sea salt-- yum!  I wish I ordered the large fries because they were soo good, but the regular was plenty enough.  I'm looking forward to returning to Philly and going to Hunger Burger again.  

By the way, a portion of their proceeds go to feed children in need-- very cool.
So tasty!!! Best guacamole I've ever had. Love the vibes of this restaurant. Very relaxed, great service and aesthetically pleasing restaurant.

Excellent food
Best Pizza in NPR
Old skool Italian ambience
Spotless facility 
Locally owned and operated 
Please support

Mooyah is a top notch place, very clean and very friendly. The food was outstanding. What I like about Mooyah is they have a very flexible menu that can meet many different diets. If you're vegetarian they have something for you. If you're Keto they have plenty of options for you. I did not have the fries  but my daughter said they were fantastic. She also had a milkshake and I took a sip and it was very good. Be patient because it gets crowded at lunch but the wait is worth it.
Not only was their subs, dynamite, after adding a few personal touches, it was a downright taste explosion. I recommend the Hook & Ladder.

To be fair the food at this place is great but ordering can often become a huge annoyance. They say they're open for phone orders but rarely ever answer calls. The past few times we tried to order we had to call 10 times until someone finally picked up the phone, other times it goes straight to voicemail. Not sure if it's an issue with their phones but it definitely will turn away customers when it's so difficult to simply get someone to pick up the phone to place an order.
This place was suggested by a local. Everything we had from them so far has been stellar! Cuban is amazing, Tina is fabulous and the Greek salad is outstanding!

So we were at the Embassy Suites and due to covid they had very little to offer in food. We decided to call Roma and have something delivered. There was four of us so I won't go into detail about everything ordered, suffice it to say that it was all hot, fresh and delicious !! I was pleasantly surprised by the fast, friendly delivery service and great food. I had never eaten at Roma before but I certainly will now. Outstanding job guys !!

Open for outdoor dining, we checked out Flatwater on a Sunday for lunch, and it did not disappoint! I opted for a Deep Eddy Lemon & Soda alone with the Wedge Salad (shrimp added). It was absolutely delicious! While no tables were open at the time on the canal, I certainly can't wait to come back and check it out for low key drinks and catching up with friends.

Thank you to the staff for a great lunch!

I'm a huge fan of Panda Express, but this was the first time I've come the Gallatin location and was severely disappointed. Panda Express is an expensive restaurant for cheap Asian cuisine, so I always have high standards that this location unfortunately didn't meet. I went to the restaurant mid-afternoon expecting good service and even better food, yet the serving size and quality were both severely under par. I got about half the amount of rice compared to previous dining experiences at the Hendersonville Indian Lake location, and a third of the chicken I've gotten before. Included are the pictures, mine is with shrimp, my girlfriend's with just chicken - I even payed extra for shrimp and got less rice and chicken than a normal meal! In conclusion, this restaurant is not worth the drive over, the money for the food, or your time. Go to the Hendersonville Indian Lake location for much better food and service at 208 N Anderson Ln. Hendersonville, TN.
Great covid safety precautions. Delicious filet minion on the teppan grill! Very friendly staff. Looking forward to going again!

Definitely my new favorite brunch spot and the prix-fixe weekend brunch is such a great deal!  You definitely won't leave hungry or disappointed.  There's something for every kind of diner, whether you're more adventurous (the rabbit frittata) or more traditional.  I had the Dutch shrimp and grits and it was cooked perfectly.  My boyfriend's dad doesn't even like grits and he absolutely loved these.  My boyfriend got the Parker House roll sandwich and said the brown sugar bacon had just the right amount of sweetness and that it wasn't overpowering.  His parents got the special 4 cheese omelet and the smoked sausage, red cabbage, and gouda omelet--they both loved them.

Definitely check out this charming new restaurant!

Gorgeous view since Boathouse at Hendry's Beach is literally on the beach with a nice waitress.

Not a lot of parking spots in the summer due to the number of beach goers.

Fish is cooked perfectly.  Our table ordered both the Mahi Mahi Salad and the Local Sole fish entrée. Unfortunately, the Sole Fish entrée is super bland (the lemon caper butter marination might as well have been invisible because my taste buds didn't pick it up at all).  The Mahi Mahi salad was of good quality but nothing memorable.

If you do choose to eat here, definitely pick their Cioppino (which also happens to be Boathouse at Hendry's Beach's Signature Dish).  Again, the tomato based seafood dish was cooked perfectly and the lightly spicy soupy sauce was thicker than broth which is a bonus in my book.  The garlic bread complimented this dish perfectly for dipping.

You should definitely make reservations if you decide to come here.

Ate with party of nine, which group they could not seat in one place, so broke into groups of 5 an 4. OK, our bad, only so many seats and booths, no reservation. I had the broiled salmon. Fairly small piece, very thin, but tasty, offered with carrots, which I did not want, substituted cole slaw, which was good, Also served with home fries, which were good. Spouse had Beef Stroganov. Rated it 'OK' also served with carrots, not a fav. Two had corned beef and cabbage, rated it good, and took some home. One complained the cabbage wasn't properly done. Another had pork chops; tasted OK but were very thin, a little dry. 
Didn't get reports from the other table. In my view the food was OK, not memorable. My Salmon dinner was over-priced at $33. Heck of a better deal at Pepe's Mexican at $15.95, bigger piece of fish, Chile Relleno and with a better side and fruit salsa. And the carrots? No broccoli, no green beans just boiled carrots the only veggie?. 
The only plus was a great server - sorry I didn't get her name.
